core_obligations: Preserve decidability, time-constructible superlogarithmic gap and superpolynomially small error assumptions.
Retain full query padding and both entropy contradiction cases.
Retain the complete reduction to Entropy Difference; target is formal Theorem39, not informal introductory statements.
difficulty_reason: The authors pad reduction queries while preserving the Kolmogorov gap, then show the sampler output must have a detectable entropy gap. A lexicographically first counterexample is compressible, and high-mass output sets yield short conditional descriptions, contradicting the reduction correctness. Entropy Difference then gives SZK containment.
